bio: As if straight out of a picture book, this beautiful inn stands on the edge of the forest. Inside, a warm and welcoming atmosphere reigns; outside, there is a charming terrace. Ernst Hunger Jr and his wife Brigitte run this long-standing family business with great dedication, delighting diners with good food and friendly service. The cooking is regional but also features Mediterranean and contemporary influences – from steak and fish to locally hunted game and vegetarian options. The dishes are delicious and very reasonably priced. The bottom line: this is a place people love – so be sure to reserve in advance. Modern, cosy guestrooms for overnight stays....
